headline: Argentina Capital Goods Imports Fall Amid Higher Freight Costs
summary: Imports of capital goods and production machinery in Argentina declined nearly 14% in both volume and value, while prices rose 8.5% driven by higher freight costs.
why: Declining capital goods imports often point to lower domestic investment in productive capacity and machinery by local businesses.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Lower capital goods import volumes signal reduced industrial retooling and investment.
